target: acceptance 3 fail-closed AT THE INTEGRATION POINT — a broken signal list must stop `advance specd`, not fall through. The classifier refusing in isolation is worthless if the gate only checks exit 7.
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/irreversible/drop_column.md" t.md; IRREVERSIBLE_SIGNALS="$PWD/absent.txt" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance t.md specd >/dev/null 2>&1; c=$?; st=$(grep -m1 "^status:" t.md | sed "s/status: //"); printf '{"c":%s,"status":"%s"}' "$c" "$st"
